newsitem.title: GERMANY: Two-tonne German church bell drops a clanger.
newsitem.headline: Two-tonne German church bell drops a clanger.

text.p: A bell weighing 1,810 kg (3,980 lb) crashed five metres (16 feet) onto a concrete floor and smashed to pieces while being rung in one of Germany's most famous churches, the fire brigade said on Sunday.
The 167-year-old bell belonged to Frankfurt's Paulskirche (Saint Paul's church), site of Germany's first democratic parliament in 1848 and now used for civic occasions.
In breaking its mooring, it also dislodged a smaller, 500 kg (1,100 lb) bell, which became jammed in the bell frame and remained undamaged in Saturday's incident. No one was hurt.
